WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
q3_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year,
           CASE WHEN n.store_id = 900 THEN 'Online' ELSE cs.region END AS region,
           SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d  ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39
      AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, region
)
SELECT region,
       MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) AS last_year_q3,
       MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) AS prior_year_q3,
       ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END) / 
                      MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales END) - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM q3_sales
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY CASE WHEN region = 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, region
